text: Integration coverage audit before trusted checks: current consumer_any_apis/consumer_app.rs appears sync-only. Add genuine Any async FFI snapshot exercise in the same real two-provider test (await one-shot, assert two typed results, correct lifetime after completion/drop); existing async Specific tests plus mock cancellation do not measure positive native Any async. Add bounded no-offer/empty phase before provider starts if feasible, using separate consumer mode/test; test exact documented native outcome and do not claim Ok(empty) if native returns error. Error assertions should match actual expected ServiceFailedReason when claiming exact propagation; is_err alone is weaker. Preserve discriminating provider absent consumer config and actually offered different interface. Stop adding broad unmeasured claims, finish scoped source/tests/report, then trusted native checks will measure outcomes.
